The package fetches architecture-specific `.tar.xz` files from the GitHub releases page, and the checksums for both x86_64 and aarch64 are explicitly provided and match standard cryptographic hash practices.

The code does not modify system configuration outside the package root, nor does it attempt to exfiltrate data or execute remote code.
